blurb: Guests can rent Yamaha WaveRunners, Carolina Skiff boats, and pontoon boats for fishing, crabbing, and cruising on Barnegat Bay. The shop offers a full-service bait and tackle shop with fishing poles, crab traps, bait, and more. There is also a free crabbing and fishing pier behind the shop and a Waterside Café serving breakfast and lunch with scenic views.
